_comment: Copy to ~/.config/meeting-recorder/config.json and fill in. This file is private: it is read by the scripts and by the skill, never committed. Tokens are NOT here (Drive auth lives in rclone).

work.identity: Your Name, founder of Company — meetings with customers, advisors, partners

share_message.ca: Et comparteixo el resum de la nostra reunió. Qualsevol correcció o matís, digue-m'ho. Gràcies.
share_message.es: Te comparto el resumen de nuestra reunión. Cualquier corrección o matiz, dímelo. Gracias.
share_message.en: Sharing the summary of our meeting. Any correction or nuance, let me know. Thanks.

crm.rules: One free-text paragraph with your CRM conventions, e.g. which field holds the follow-up owner, which fields are rollups and must never be written, how to classify interaction types.

personal.identity: Your Name — personal meetings, not related to Company
